plan.title: Alan Turing: The Man Who Cracked the Impossible
plan.description: A quick look at Alan Turing, the mathematician who helped break a wartime code and imagined thinking machines. Learn why his ideas still shape the computers we use today.

beats.narration: He broke a code that seemed unbreakable, and helped end a war. Then he imagined machines that could think.
Alan Turing was a British mathematician. In World War Two, his work helped break Germany's Enigma messages, saving countless lives.
He also asked a bold question: can machines think? Every computer and every AI you use today carries his ideas.
